_readme: Language registry. `order` is the picker order. A language appears in the playable once content/<code>.json exists and passes `npm run check`. A new language needs an entry here plus its content file; nothing else changes.
_source: Languages from Livewire 17 Sep 2026 (Mandarin, Cantonese, Vietnamese, Arabic, Hindi) plus English, as confirmed in Gamify's 21 Sep email.

cmn.name: Mandarin
cmn._pending: Client to confirm the written script (asked 21 Sep: Simplified for Mandarin?). Once confirmed as Simplified set script Hans, htmlLang zh-Hans and font han-sc.

yue.name: Cantonese
yue._pending: Client to confirm the written script (asked 21 Sep: Traditional for Cantonese?). Once confirmed as Traditional set script Hant, htmlLang zh-Hant (or zh-HK) and font han-tc (or han-hk for Hong Kong forms).

ar.name: Arabic
ar._pending: numerals: empty means Western digits (0 to 9). Confirm with the client whether scores should use Arabic Indic digits instead; if so set numerals to arab.
